description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Session' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Startup' namespace. It defines methods to initialize and manage user sessions in the OpenCart admin system, including session start, handling session IDs via cookies, and setting session parameters.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing user sessions during the startup phase in the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the session, retrieves or generates the session ID, starts the session, updates session expiration settings, and configures cookie parameters for session management.
